tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background behind cards (Compose: colorScheme.background).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and chart plot areas (colorScheme.surface).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Chart cards and grouped lists on background.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Unselected chips, segmented controls, table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks and pressed states.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Progress tracks and dividers that need more weight than outline-variant.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and KPI values on background, surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels on surface and surface-container (6.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus-adjacent strokes (3:1 on surface). Not for body text.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and chart gridlines.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Filled buttons, selected tab indicator, focus ring, the single-series chart color.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Selected chip, selected segmented button, info highlights.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The dashboard summary band, as in the mockups. The dashboard hides the shared top app bar and draws its own title row inside the band. One per screen.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Headline numbers and titles on hero.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and captions on hero (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Fills only: FAB, a highlighted KPI marker, the active-period dot. Never body text on white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (5.8:1 light, 7:1 dark). White on accent fails contrast.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text and icons on surface (links, 'Ver detalle').

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Brand teal. Secondary actions and the collected-money accent.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive delta text and icon on surface or success-container. Always with ▲ or a word.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Background of positive badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / due-soon text and icon on surface or warning-container.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Negative delta, overdue, cancellations. Text on surface or error-container.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and the error card.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informative badges (e.g. 'Migración').

tokens.name: info-container
tokens.usage: Background of info badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (indigo). Validated as a 5-slot set on surface in both themes; assign in order 1→5, never cycle.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (teal).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (amber).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (magenta). A 6th category folds into 'Otros' in chart-other.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The folded 'Otros' slice or series. Always labeled.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and baselines; recessive by design.

styles.name: kpi-hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure in the hero band. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: kpi-delta
styles.usage: Change vs previous period under a KPI.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Screen title in the hero band.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: KPI and hero labels, sentence case (report labels are long and are matched verbatim by tests).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, delta under value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between KPI tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero band bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, skeleton lines, bar ends (4px on bars under 16px wide).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: KpiTile and ChartCard.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of the hero band; bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented controls, pills.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: KpiTile resting over the hero band edge. Dark theme uses tonal surfaces instead.
